summary: Variables for upgrading a 2.4 multi-node controller and hub to 2.6 enterprise: registry credentials, gateway admin password, main URL (the load balancer) and database, controller and hub settings from 2.4, new EDA settings; automationhub_main_url is no longer used for load balancer configuration in 2.6.
questions: Is automationhub_main_url still used in AAP 2.6?
What variables do I need to upgrade hub to AAP 2.6 enterprise?
Where do I set the load balancer URL in AAP 2.6?

answer_card.title: automationhub_main_url in 2.6
answer_card.answer_md:
When upgrading a multi-node controller and hub deployment to 2.6, keep the `automationhub_admin_password` and `automationhub_pg_*` variables, but `automationhub_main_url` is no longer used for load balancer configuration. Set the load balancer URL on the platform gateway instead:

```ini
automationgateway_main_url=<load balancer URL>
```
